extra_vocab.en: a very big change in the way people do or think about something
extra_vocab.note: 在商務情境多半指科技或產業的重大變革，如 digital revolution。拼法和發音都很像文章裡的 renovations（整修），要特別分清楚：revolution 是變革，renovation 是翻新整修。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「某領域的重大變革」要用 a revolution in + 名詞，介系詞用 in，不用 of。

example.en: Several revolutions in technology have changed how we shop.
example.zh: 科技上的幾次重大變革改變了我們購物的方式。

example.en: The industrial revolution changed the way factories make products.
example.zh: 工業革命改變了工廠製造產品的方式。

example.en: The digital revolution has made online shopping part of daily life.
example.zh: 數位革命讓網路購物成為日常生活的一部分。

example.en: This small device could start a revolution in the printing business.
example.zh: 這個小裝置可能在印刷業引發一場變革。

example.en: Every company must adapt to the technological revolution to stay competitive.
example.zh: 每家公司都必須適應科技革命，才能保持競爭力。

examples.en: Our new system is causing a revolution in how we handle orders.
examples.zh: 我們的新系統正在徹底改變處理訂單的方式。

examples.en: Online shopping brought a revolution to the retail industry.
examples.zh: 網路購物為零售業帶來了重大變革。

examples.en: Experts say electric cars will lead to a revolution in transportation.
examples.zh: 專家說電動車將帶來交通運輸的重大變革。

similar.diff: major change 語氣中性，只說變化很大；revolution 強調徹底、劇烈地改變。

example.en: The new policy is a major change for all our branches.
example.zh: 這項新政策對我們所有分公司都是一大改變。

similar.diff: breakthrough 指重大突破或新發現；revolution 指整個做法或產業被徹底改變。

example.en: The new battery was a breakthrough for the electric car industry.
example.zh: 這款新電池是電動車產業的重大突破。

confusable.diff: renovation 是把建築或房間整修翻新；revolution 是革命或重大變革，兩個字拼法與發音都很像。

example.en: The hotel closed for a three-month renovation of all its rooms.
example.zh: 這家飯店為了全面整修客房而休業三個月。

confusable.diff: evolution 是慢慢的演變、逐步發展；revolution 是突然而徹底的重大變革。

example.en: The evolution of our product took ten years of small improvements.
example.zh: 我們產品的演進經歷了十年一點一滴的改良。

example.en: The company announced a big change in its schedule.
example.zh: 公司宣布了時程上的一項重大改變。

example.en: Innovation helps our company stay ahead of its competitors.
example.zh: 創新讓我們公司能領先競爭對手。

example.en: Online sales are a growing trend in our industry.
example.zh: 網路銷售是我們產業中日益成長的趨勢。

derived.link: revolution + -ary，變成形容詞「有革命性的」，像 necessary、customary

example.en: This revolutionary software saves us hours of work every week.
example.zh: 這套革命性的軟體每週為我們省下好幾個小時的工作。

derived.link: revolution + -ize，變成動詞「使徹底改變」，像 organize、finalize

example.en: The internet has revolutionized the way we do business.
example.zh: 網際網路徹底改變了我們做生意的方式。

senses.en: a very big change in the way people do or think about something

example.en: Cloud storage created a revolution in how offices keep their files.
example.zh: 雲端儲存徹底改變了辦公室保存檔案的方式。

senses.en: an attempt by many people to change a government by force
senses.distinguish: 談政治或歷史時是「革命」；談產品、科技、產業時是「重大變革」。

example.en: The factory was closed during the revolution many years ago.
example.zh: 這間工廠在多年前的革命期間關閉了。
